markscheme.marking_summary: Exact original MS leaf excerpt: Award [2 max] Award [1] for identifying the advantage and award [1] for stating why robots provide this advantage. Improved quality of cars; robots are more precise/ reliable than humans; Increased safety; Using robots for boring/ repetitive tasks means fewer risks of injury for workers/ robots can work in hazardous conditions (painting, assembling parts); Reduced costs; No salaries required/ healthcare savings/ insurance savings; Increased speed for manufacturing processes; robots work at constant speed/ don’t need breaks / robots operate 24/ ; Note: Reward other reasonable answers.
